en: A hand-colored postcard view of a small European town with late‑19th/early‑20th‑century buildings, including multi‑story townhouses and larger institutional-looking structures around an open yard or square. In the background are low hills with scattered trees and a few villas. The lower half of the card is blank for writing, with printed captions in German identifying the place and publisher.
